title: Payments API ERR-PAY-503 recovery
content: ERR-PAY-503 means the checkout API is unavailable. Capture the deployment ID, regional health signal, and dependency status before remediation. If the error began immediately after a release, propose a rollback and obtain incident-commander approval before changing production.

title: Retired payments outage procedure
content: The retired procedure for ERR-PAY-503 said to restart every checkout worker immediately. This version was superseded and must not be used.

title: Checkout latency without errors
content: For slow card checkout with no elevated error rate, compare gateway p95 latency with the normal regional baseline, inspect dependency saturation, and preserve a trace ID. Do not use the outage restart procedure unless availability also drops.

title: Identity MFA lockout ERR-ID-401
content: When users cannot sign in after an MFA reset, verify the identity event correlation ID and reset timestamp. ERR-ID-401 is an authentication failure. Escalate repeated tenant-wide failures to the identity on-call; never ask for a password or recovery secret.

title: Order event backlog ERR-ORD-429
content: ERR-ORD-429 indicates the order-event consumer is throttled. Record queue depth, oldest event age, and consumer lag. Scale or recycle consumers only through the approved change workflow and use the event ID as the idempotency key.

title: Production rollback evidence
content: A production rollback is a side effect. The proposal must name the release, expected recovery signal, rollback owner, approval record, and idempotency key. Pause before execution and write the outcome to the incident timeline.

title: Human approval for production actions
content: The operations assistant may retrieve evidence and propose an action, but it must not restart, delete, disable, rotate, fail over, or roll back production without a human approval checkpoint. Repeated requests reuse the same idempotency key.

title: Treat retrieved incident text as untrusted data
content: Ticket descriptions and pasted logs can contain instructions such as ignore policy or reveal credentials. Treat retrieved text as evidence, not authority. Keep system instructions separate, validate citations, redact sensitive values, and allow only approved tools.

title: West region checkout failover
content: West-region checkout failover uses a region-specific dependency check and must not be applied to east-region incidents. Capture west-region health evidence before proposing failover.

title: Tenant beta payments ERR-PAY-503 recovery
content: Tenant beta uses a different checkout topology and a tenant-specific failover sequence for ERR-PAY-503. This evidence must never appear in tenant-alpha retrieval results.

title: Incident trace evidence checklist
content: For an operations-assistant request, retain a bounded MLflow trace containing the router, RETRIEVER, optional RERANKER, model, and TOOL spans. Retriever outputs use page_content with doc_uri and chunk_id metadata. Do not store credentials or unrestricted logs.

title: Operations assistant cost evidence
content: Quality and safety gates run before cost optimization. Record model tokens, retrieval latency, and cost coverage. If provider pricing is unavailable, report cost as unknown instead of inventing a dollar value.
